ariaControlsReview: The Submit an inquiry button references the single existing native inquiry-dialog element. That dialog is intentionally closed until click; verified opening, closing, label, containment, focus trap and focus restoration in the functional test.
nonTextAndScrollReview: Decorative arrow is aria-hidden. Modal error focus scrolls its internal content; its title may be above the current scroll position, not an overlapping floating panel. Modal confirmation text is on the same opaque high-contrast background. Enlarged 200% modal axe reports zero violations and no incomplete items.
